items.name: ff-same-alarm
items.text: [curious] Same alarm... [short pause] different life. [warmly] Two hundred a month, from twenty-five. [building excitement] Every year, the line moves. [confident] At eight percent... about seven hundred thousand by sixty-five. [softly] You put in ninety-six. [warmly] Time bought the mornings.

items.name: lf-ten-minutes
items.text: [tired] Hour two of crying... [sighs] and you're running on empty. [gently] Here's what the NHS says. [softly] If no one can take over... put baby safely in the cot. Close the door. Go to another room. [warmly] Ten minutes. Breathe. Then go back. [tenderly] Stepping out isn't giving up... it's how you come back calm.
